name: Kraftia Corporation
summary: Kraftia Corporation engages in design, construction, and installation of power infrastructure construction business in Japan. The company offers distribution line and underground line works; and electrical work for commercial buildings, office buildings, factories, educational and cultural facilities, resort facilities, and renewable energy power plants.
